description: Europea Seguros helps users get answers about funeral insurance products and generate price quotes for funeral insurance using birth date and Spanish postal code. The app supports one-shot FAQ answers, one-shot quote requests, a guided quote flow, and a visual quote result widget with plan prices, payment frequencies, and coverage details.
